title: carex maritima f. inflata
intro: Carex maritima f. inflata, commonly known as the inflated sea-sedge, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Carex maritima f. inflata may include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it a potential treatment for minor cuts and scrapes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
